classification: closed actual prime-to-ell arithmetic seed subobligation inside W04, independently reviewed
claim: For every original field-character datum with ell not dividing order chi', construct the complete rank-two and rank-three IsSeed representations in arbitrarily large prescribed weight classes, retaining the rank-two supplied CM twist.
verification_kind: Authenticated bounded pinned interfaces; eight directly inspected primary references; exact generic polarization identities and small-prime Bernoulli controls. The complete existence proof is in the note.
quantifiers: Every odd ell, including 3; every original N,w,K,L,chi',eta,theta,j satisfying the full field-character contract and ell not dividing order chi'.
Every prescribed Qbar_ell-to-C embedding and every lower weight bound B; finite coefficient extensions are allowed inside Qbar_ell, without enlarging K or L.
Rank three when chi' differs from eta; rank two for the original supplied IsTwist character kappa and its prescribed restriction ka.

Residual characteristic-polynomial identities hold on every Galois element; away inertia is exact at every prime including 2; each ell-adic place has the original ordered flag and full residual decomposition-group characters.

decisive_interfaces.integral_constants: Nontrivial prime-to-ell phi supplies a unit 1-phi(a)a^k with a=1 mod w ell. Integral smoothed congruences yield the exact w Euler factor and lambda-divisibility, without a Bernoulli denominator loss.
decisive_interfaces.all_cusps: The primitive constant-term formula vanishes off the infinity class; all remaining constants are unit multiples of L(1-k,chi)/2.
decisive_interfaces.same_character_lift: Cusp stabilizers have order dividing 2C, so the boundary eigensheaf sequence is exact even when ell divides the diamond group order. omega^12 descends to an ample line; Serre vanishing gives the exact boundary lift.
decisive_interfaces.ordinary: The lifted packet has a_ell=1 mod lambda. Kato 17.1/17.7 applies without residual irreducibility; converting its arithmetic Frobenius alpha^{-1} on the cohomological line gives the unit quotient alpha.
decisive_interfaces.away_type: Carayol Theorem A over Q plus equality of central-character and representation conductor forces principal series with one unramified character and zero monodromy.
decisive_interfaces.rank_three: phi=chi' eta, k=m+1, r3=Sym^2 rho/det rho. The nonquadratic residual condition excludes quadratic self-twists; infinite ordinary projective inertia then forces connected PGL2 and irreducibility on every open subgroup.
decisive_interfaces.rank_two: phi=chi'^2 eta, k=2m+1, sigma=rho epsilon^{-m} chi'^{-1}; det sigma=eta theta. Clifford theory and the exact residual condition prove irreducibility on G_L.
decisive_interfaces.polarization: Q=[[0,0,-2],[0,1,0],[-2,0,0]], P3=Q ad0(rho)(c); J=[[0,1],[-1,0]], P2=J sigma(c). Both pairings are symmetric with original multiplier one.
decisive_interfaces.automorphy: Gelbart-Jacquet adjoint transfer; cyclic prime-degree Arthur-Clozel base change, with norm self-twists excluded by irreducible restrictions. Rank three uses exactly epsilon^{-1}. Rank two uses BC(pi_f^vee) tensor |det|^{1/2} tensor Xi_chi tensor the prescribed Xi_ka; its CM infinitesimal parameters are {m-1/2,-m-1/2} and {m+1/2,-m+1/2}, with exact geometric-Frobenius and positive algSat factors.

limitations: This does not assert unrestricted Seed2, Seed3 or PropEG for arbitrary ell-power character order; it supplies the exact prime-to-ell character case used in SeedPtOf.
The particular IsTwist character remains an explicit rank-two input.
No uniform bound on weight, coefficient degree, automorphic dimension or integral Selmer torsion is asserted.
The marked PointTheorem, characteristic-prime curve point, support localization and complete prime chain must still be applied with their exact hypotheses.
No whole RH or GRH proof-map node and no Lean project build is certified.

primary_sources.interface: Main Theorem 8.2: smoothed integral measure and integral Kummer congruences; the unit smoothing factor is supplied in the proof.
Definition 4.2, Remark 4.3, Theorem 4.5(1): chi1=1, chi2=chi primitive, level=f=conductor chi; Gauss ratio cancels and extra Euler-factor set is empty.

Sections 1.4-1.6 and Corollary 1.6.2: fine modular curves and integral q-expansion principle. The coarse diamond eigensheaf cusp lift is proved in the note; blanket eigensheaf base change is not cited.
Theorem 6.1 and Lemma 6.11: classical Galois representations and lifting a residual eigenpacket in a finite free DVR module. A specified eigenvector lift is not claimed.
Hypotheses 0.3 and Theorem A. F=Q has odd degree, so no added finite discrete-series place is required. Exact primitive central conductor forces zero monodromy by the conductor argument in the note.

Proposition 17.1 and Section 17.7, no residual irreducibility. The cohomological unramified line has arithmetic Frobenius alpha^{-1}; its dual gives the arithmetic normalization's unramified quotient alpha.
Theorem 9.3 and Remark 9.9: adjoint transfer with cuspidality outside the quadratic self-twist case.
Chapter III Theorems 4.2(a,b) and 5.1: cyclic prime-degree cuspidal base change and strong local compatibility; iterate from K to the original L. No solvable descent is used.

symbolic_identities_over_Z: The exact source symmetric-square matrix satisfies S(g)^t Q S(g)=det(g)^2 Q and det S(g)=det(g)^3, with det Q=-4.
g^t J g=det(g)J; for trace-zero involution C of determinant -1, JC is symmetric.
For that same C, A=-Sym^2(C) satisfies A^2=1 and QA is symmetric, modulo the exact relation u^2+vz=1.
exact_checks.scope: Polynomial identities are exact generic calculations. The finite Bernoulli examples test normalization and indispensable hypotheses, not the general existence theorem.
